highlights.title: Copy tells you when it didn't work
highlights.text: If the browser blocks the clipboard, for example on a plain http address, Copy now says "Couldn't copy" instead of "Copied", so you know to copy the text another way.

highlights.title: Unpairing Telegram clears old buttons
highlights.text: When you unpair Telegram, approval and question cards already in the chat lose their buttons, so an old tap can't approve or answer anything.

fixes: Phone line charts drop the repeated year from their date labels, so the dates have room.
On Windows, closing kwant by force no longer leaves docker.exe running in the background.
When a chat's budget is paused, the message box no longer leaves an empty band above the banner.
Answering an approval in the chat now clears its "needs you" bar and sidebar row right away.
